a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to operate up to 8 means we'll almost certainly both be caught short. The reserve has exactly 4 now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. I'm telling you rather than doing it quietly. If you take too, the split is random. After that I'll operate every round to help refill the reserve for you, and I won't take again.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
